SELECT XX.BUYER, XX.BUYER_NAME, XX.SELLER_COM_NAME, XX.SELLER, XX.PO_CREATE_DATE, XX.PX_NO, XX.PO_NO, XX.PO_NO_CNT, XX.PROCESS_TYPE, XX.PO_SEQ, XX.IV_QTY, XX.DS_DATE, XX.TOT_QTY, XX.AGENT_PRICE * (XX.SUM_CD_QTY-NVL(XX.SUM_INV_QTY,0)) AS AGENT_TOT_AMT, XX.AGENT_PRICE * (XX.SUM_CD_QTY-NVL(XX.SUM_INV_QTY,0)) AS SELLER_AMT, FLOOR(XX.AGENT_PRICE * (XX.SUM_CD_QTY-NVL(XX.SUM_INV_QTY,0))/10) AS TAX_AMT, XX.PURCHASER_NAME, XX.DELY_TO_LOCATION, XX.DOC_TYPE, XX.PO_REMARK, XX.DS_FLAG, XX.DS_YN, XX.REF_ADD_USER_NAME, XX.REF_ADD_USER_CNT, XX.PURCHASER_CNT, XX.LOCATION_CNT, XX.REF_PR_NO, XX.BUYER_ITEM_NO, XX.BYIT_COMORG_CODE, XX.CONTRACT_NO, XX.CONTRACT_SEQ, XX.DESCRIPTION, XX.MAKER_NAME, XX.SPECIFICATION, XX.ITEM_QTY, XX.CD_QTY, XX.INV_POSS_QTY, XX.INV_COMP_QTY, XX.UNIT_MEASURE, XX.AGENT_PRICE, XX.SUPP_PRICE, XX.RD_DATE, XX.ITEM_PO_REMARK, XX.POP_KEY, XX.BFRE_STCK_YN, XX.MSDS_NO, XX.SUM_INV_QTY, XX.SUM_CD_QTY, XX.COD_CHECK, XX.MSDS_CHECK, XX.REQ_CHECK, XX.BUY_CLOSE_DATE_CHK
,XX.QRY_STR1, XX.QRY_STR2, XX.QRY_STR3, XX.QRY_STR4, XX.LEGACY_PO_NO, XX.PURCHASER_ID, XX.TR_BUYER, XX.STX_RPT, XX.DSN_RPT
FROM ( SELECT /*selectSellerMpIvTranStatementDivsnWriteList*/ A.BUYER , F_GET_EXPORT_BUYER_NAME(B.BUYER, B.PO_NO, B.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS BUYER_NAME -- 공급받는자 , (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = A.AGENT) AS SELLER_COM_NAME -- 공급원 , B.SELLER , A.PO_CREATE_DATE --발주일 , P.REF_NO AS PX_NO --주문번호 , B.PO_NO --발주번호 , COUNT(DISTINCT B.PO_NO) OVER() AS PO_NO_CNT --발주번호 수 , A.PROCESS_TYPE , B.PO_SEQ , NVL(B.IV_QTY,0) AS IV_QTY , C.DS_DATE --납품예정일 , COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY C.BUYER, C.PO_NO, C.DS_DATE) AS TOT_QTY --품목수 , SUM(C.CD_QTY) OVER(PARTITION BY C.BUYER, C.PO_NO, C.DS_DATE) AS SUM_CD_QTY , DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'X' , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE, 2, '', A.PURCHASER_NAME) , A.PURCHASER_NAME) AS PURCHASER_NAME --발주자 , NVL((SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', B.WAREHOUSE_CODE, A.BUYER) AND TYPE = 'C012' --고객사 별 배송지정보 AND CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001', A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) ), A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION --납품장소 , A.DOC_TYPE , A.PO_REMARK --비고 , A.DS_FLAG , B.DS_YN , (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = P.REF_ADD_USER_ID) AS REF_ADD_USER_NAME , COUNT(DISTINCT DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'X', DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE, 2, '', P.REF_ADD_USER_ID) , P.REF_ADD_USER_ID)) OVER() AS REF_ADD_USER_CNT --요청자 수 , COUNT(DISTINCT DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'X', DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE, 2, '', A.PURCHASER_NAME) , A.PURCHASER_NAME)) OVER() AS PURCHASER_CNT --발주자 수 , COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(( SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', B.WAREHOUSE_CODE, A.BUYER) AND TYPE = 'C012' --고객사 별 배송지정보 AND CODE = DECODE(A.PROCESS_TYPE,'2','001', A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) ), A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) ) OVER() AS LOCATION_CNT --납품장소 수
--------------- 이상 발주 헤더정보 ------------------------------ --------------- 이하 발주 상세정보 ------------------------------ , B.REF_PR_NO --관리번호 , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO --품목코드 , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ , B.DESCRIPTION --품목명 , B.DESCRIPTION||DECODE(TRIM(B.MAKER_NAME),NULL,'',' / '||B.MAKER_NAME) AS MAKER_NAME -- 품명/제조사 , B.SPECIFICATION --규격 , B.ITEM_QTY --발주수량 , C.CD_QTY --납품(예정)수량 , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', B.DO_QTY-NVL(( SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'),0) , B.DO_QTY-NVL(B.IV_QTY,0)) AS INV_POSS_QTY -- 납품가능수량 , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', NVL(( SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) FROM ICOMIVDT WHERE BUYER = C.BUYER AND PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND STATUS <> 'D'),0) , NVL(B.IV_QTY,0)) AS INV_COMP_QTY -- 기납품수량 , B.UNIT_MEASURE -- 단위 --, DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', B.AGENT_PRICE, B.UNIT_PRICE) AS UNIT_PRICE , B.AGENT_PRICE -- 단가 --, DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', B.AGENT_PRICE, B.UNIT_PRICE) * C.CD_QTY AS SUPP_PRICE , B.AGENT_PRICE * C.CD_QTY AS SUPP_PRICE -- 공급가액 , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2', TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.RD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') - DECODE(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'D'),3,1,2) ,'YYYYMMDD') , B.RD_DATE) AS RD_DATE -- 납기요청일 , B.PO_REMARK||DECODE(TRIM(B.REF_IF_NO),NULL,NULL,'('||B.REF_IF_NO||')') AS ITEM_PO_REMARK -- 품목별비고 , A.BUYER||A.PO_NO||B.PO_SEQ||C.DS_DATE AS POP_KEY , DECODE(A.DOC_TYPE,'S','선입고','') AS BFRE_STCK_YN , F_GET_MSDS_INFO(B.BUYER, B.BUYER_ITEM_NO ,1) AS MSDS_NO , (SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) AS INV_QTY FROM ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE IVDT.BUYER = B.BUYER AND IVDT.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND IVDT.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND IVDT.DS_DATE = C.DS_DATE AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D') SUM_INV_QTY , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(COD.CODE),0,'N','Y') FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE 1=1 AND COD.CODE = B.CMS_CATEG_ID AND COD.TYPE = 'CM11' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y') AS COD_CHECK --ICOMCOD1 CHECK , (SELECT DECODE(TRIM(F.MSDS_NO),'','Y','MS88888888','Y','N') FROM ICOMBYIT F WHERE F.BUYER = B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND F.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO) AS MSDS_CHECK --BYIT.MSDS_NO CHECK , (SELECT DECODE(COUNT(REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO),0,'N','Y') FROM KEP_CMC_REQ REQ WHERE 1=1 AND REQ.BUYER = B.BUYER AND REQ.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE AND REQ.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND REQ.AGENT = A.AGENT AND REQ.REQ_STATUS NOT IN ('B','C','D','N','T')) AS REQ_CHECK --REQ CHECK , F_GET_BUY_CLOSE_DATE_CHK(B.BUYER, B.PO_NO, B.PO_SEQ, A.AGENT) AS BUY_CLOSE_DATE_CHK
, Z.QRY_STR1 , Z.QRY_STR2 , Z.QRY_STR3 , Z.QRY_STR4 , DECODE(TRIM(B.LEGACY_PO_NO), NULL,'N',B.LEGACY_PO_NO) AS LEGACY_PO_NO , A.PURCHASER_ID , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'2',B.WAREHOUSE_CODE,B.BUYER) AS TR_BUYER /* SLOGIC-BEGIN (P06-0000005) */ , --Y : 직납이면, 리포트 파일 오픈하지 않는다. 30분뒤에 하라고 메시지 출력 ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'N', 'Y') FROM BNTSLGDEF A1, BNTSLGIMP B1 WHERE A1.SLG_ID = B1.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A1.OPEN_DATE AND A1.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B1.OPEN_DATE AND B1.CLOSE_DATE AND B1.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code} -- BUYER AND A1.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000005' -- ID하드코딩 ) AS STX_RPT /* SLOGIC-END */ /* SLOGIC-BEGIN (P06-0000006) */ , --Y : 두산인프라코어 데이터 전송 ( SELECT DECODE(COUNT(*), 0, 'N', 'Y') DSN_RPT FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code} -- BUYER AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000006' -- ID하드코딩 ) AS DSN_RPT /* SLOGIC-END */
FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, ICOMPORS C, ICOMPRDT P
, ( SELECT Y.QRY_STR1 , Y.QRY_STR2 , Y.QRY_STR3 , Y.QRY_STR4 , X.SLG_ID , X.DEFAULT_RPT_URL FROM /* SLOGIC-BEGIN (P06-0000002) */ (
SELECT 'P06-0000002' SLG_ID -- ID 하드코딩 , 'RD_06_S_001_83' DEFAULT_RPT_URL --디폴트 유알엘 하드코딩 , 추후 변경 /kr/epro/buy/sheet/inv_prn.jsp FROM DUAL --한건도 조회되지 않는 것 방지
) X , ( SELECT B.COL01_DATA QRY_STR1 , B.COL02_DATA QRY_STR2 , B.COL03_DATA QRY_STR3 , B.COL03_DATA QRY_STR4 , A.SLG_ID FROM BNTSLGDEF A, BNTSLGIMP B WHERE 1=1 AND A.SLG_ID = B.SLG_ID --default url을 가져오기 위해 아우터조인 AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN A.OPEN_DATE AND A.CLOSE_DATE AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN B.OPEN_DATE AND B.CLOSE_DATE AND B.COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code} --고객사 회사코드 AND A.SLG_ID = 'P06-0000002' -- ID하드코딩 ) Y /* SLOGIC-END */ WHERE 1=1 AND X.SLG_ID = Y.SLG_ID(+) ) Z
WHERE 1=1 AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ= C.PO_SEQ AND B.BUYER = P.BUYER AND B.PR_NO = P.PR_NO AND B.PR_SEQ = P.PR_SEQ AND A.AGENT = #{st_com_code} --param: session com_code AND A.COMPLETE_MARK = 'N' AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.DS_FLAG = 'Y' AND B.COMPLETE_MARK = 'N' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.COMPLETE_MARK = 'N' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND P.STATUS <> 'D' AND NVL(B.CLSD_FLAG,'N') <> 'Y' AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_PO_MNG WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND STATUS = 'S' AND TYPE IN (SELECT CODE FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'PMNGTYPE' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND TEXT4 = 'Y') ) = 0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'MHUB_CHG' AND TARGET = A.BUYER AND KEY_1 = A.PO_NO AND KEY_9 = 'N' ) = 0
AND P.REQ_USER_INFO LIKE '%'||#{st_req_user_info}||'%'
AND B.ITEM_QTY ^= B.GR_QTY
AND A.BUYER||A.PO_NO||B.PO_SEQ||C.DS_DATE IN (${pop_key})
) XX
ORDER BY XX.PO_CREATE_DATE, XX.PO_NO, XX.DS_DATE, XX.PO_SEQ
